summary: Verified prod fixes A/B/C on preview (GET-only, no mutations). (A) /api/performance/verified: headline = current accounts only (Start Trader, DEMO), overall.deals == sum(accounts.deals), 7 archived orphan accounts (2104 deals) reported separately with all required keys, integrity computed from same deal set (archived_accounts_excluded=7, archived_deals_excluded=2104, broker_verified_trades == overall.closed_positions). UI: integrity-pct reads '... 2104 deals of 7 deleted accounts archived', archived-accounts header correct, archived-row-0..6 'DELETED ACCOUNT …xxxxxx' UNKNOWN, verified-accounts lists only Start Trader; no page-level horizontal overflow at 390px (table scrolls inside its own container). (B) /api/infra/certification clock_synchronization=true with details {ea_broker_time,10800,Start Trader}; /api/infra/overview server_backups {mounted:false, files:[], newest_age_h:null}, backups list. UI cert-clock_synchronization PASS + cert-clock-detail exact text; vps-backups shows both SERVER and VPS FLEET sections + unmounted message. (C) unit tests test_prod_v1_60_28_execution_bugs + verified_performance_deleted_accounts + infra_shadow_clock_and_backups: 20 passed. Regression: presets policy_risk_cap_pct=1.0 + cap_fit on every preset; Bot Config UI shows cap banner + 8 cap-fit pills. SECURITY: found the CURRENT admin password committed (string-split to dodge scanner) in backend/tests/test_audit_p3_live_iter228.py — patched to read from env; rotation required.

critical.issue: backend/tests/test_audit_p3_live_iter228.py hardcoded the CURRENT TEST_ADMIN_PASSWORD (split into string fragments to evade gitleaks). It is in git history (commit 3465fd97). Testing agent replaced it with env lookup; password must be rotated + sessions revoked.

minor.issue: When attestation_blocked, the code pops row keys 'net','wins','losses','win_rate','profit_factor' but rows carry 'net_pnl' — per-account net_pnl still leaks on a blocked share (pre-existing), and the new 'archived' rows (net_pnl, deals, account_id_suffix, deleted_at, broker) are not stripped/masked at all on the public share.

broker_deals query .limit(20000) sorted ascending across current+archived accounts — for users with many archived deals, oldest archived deals can consume the limit and truncate headline deals. Filter headline/archived separately or use aggregation.
Soft-deleted accounts (status=deleted, doc still present, no tombstone) fall into archived as 'DELETED ACCOUNT …' with UNKNOWN env though label/env are available from the account doc.
checks.broker_reconciliation uses db.broker_deals.find_one({}) — not user-scoped (pre-existing); clock detail takes first non-paper account in natural order, not the freshest heartbeat.

issues: Integrity stamp missing space: 'archived· source: broker_deals'
Negative P&L formatted '$-27.46' while positive '+$7928.9' — use '-$27.46' and 2 decimals/thousands separators ('+$7,928.90')
Archived header/rows #52525B on near-black — low contrast
Mobile: archived table needs horizontal scroll within container (POSITIONS/DELETED columns off-screen) — acceptable but consider stacked layout
cert-clock-detail wraps inside the cell and is partially covered by the floating chat FAB
